title: AARO director's true anomalies

tellings.quote: the Pentagon has said that they have quote true anomalies that they're so stump. And this is Kosla, the new director of the Pentagon's UFO office

plain: The Pentagon has said it has "true anomalies", cases that leave it stumped, and that is coming from Jon Kosloski, the new director of AARO, the Pentagon's office for UFO reports. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff repeats this from what Kosloski said in 2024 or 2025. If true, it would mean the military's own office admits some cases cannot be explained.
